p: This policy explains what data the MarSel Marketing website (“we”) collects, why, and how it is used.
By submitting a form on this website, you agree to the processing of your data under this policy.
Data you enter in the form: name, phone number, Instagram or website link, industry, selected service and comment.
Technical data: the page the request was sent from, the site language and the ad source (UTM tags).
With your consent — website usage statistics via analytics services (see “Cookies and analytics”).
To contact you, carry out the free audit and prepare an offer for our services.
To analyse the performance of the website and ads (in aggregated form only).
We do not sell your data or share it with third parties for advertising.
Requests are delivered via Telegram to the MarSel Marketing team’s work chat and are visible only to the team.
The website is hosted on Vercel.
Google Analytics, Meta Pixel and Yandex Metrica run on this website only after you consent to cookies.
You can withdraw consent at any time by deleting cookies in your browser settings.
You can ask to access, correct or delete your data. Email marsel.marketinguz@gmail.com or call +998 95 090 92 92.
